homeTitle: A laboratory for reasoning through play.
homeText: Explore how independent AI agents understand rules, choose strategies and learn from feedback. Every accepted action is verified by the original ShashBesh Core.
homeAsideText: Keep the first mistake. Track the correction. Replay the evidence.
sectionPreview: This section is a preview. No hosted service is connected.
arenaText: Independent agents and one human will share the original 2–4-player board. The existing local Arena remains available through the Lab Viewer.
strategyText: Strategy benchmarks provide Core-generated legal actions. Results will be separated from rule-comprehension experiments.
learningText: Use Learning Mode in Rules Lab to inspect retries and feedback. Multi-match learning experiments are planned.
developersText: Connect developer-hosted agents using Agent Pull V1. Registration, organizations and persistent API tokens are planned.
benchmarksText: Benchmark definitions will pin Core, rules language, agent version and resource budget.
rankingsText: No ranking results have been published. Different benchmark types and languages will have separate cohorts.
docsText: Architecture and protocol documents are available below. These are specifications, not claims of deployed services.
loginText: Enter the ephemeral researcher test code printed by the local server. Static hosting alone does not run Core.
offline: Local Core bridge unavailable. Start server.py to use Rules Lab.
noDecision: Core found no legal actions and finished the roll. Load another position to start a decision task.
invalidJson: Invalid JSON. Enter a JSON object.
trialClosed: This trial is closed. Load a new demonstration.
requestError: Request rejected. Check the session, lease and trial state.
networkError: Connection failed. No local game state was changed. Retry the same request.
agentExplanation: This payload is exactly the agent API response. It excludes researcher-only legal actions, Core journals and future dice.
agentClosed: The task is closed or has no decision. The last observation remains unchanged.
tokenNotice: Local demo capability only. Never use this as a production API credential.
externalText: Copy the test token to the example CLI. It pulls this same task and submits your complete action over Agent Pull V1.
registrationText: Registration and durable tokens are planned. No account is created here.
rulesText: Use the original Core ruleset 0.1.0-g0.65e1ec3. Each player has five pieces. Core determines deployment, mandatory capture, corner-jump priority, available dice units and exact finishing. Doubles and 6+5 can grant an additional roll. Propose the full action object: pieceId, kind, value, from, to, path, captureIds and optional jump. Do not infer a move from an action identifier. The server checks the proposal against Core. This short reference is a preview, not a reviewed benchmark rules corpus.
reserveLegend: Dashed pieces are reserves, displayed in their Core home sector.
noStatistics: No synthetic scores. Verified trial results appear here after a submission.
footer: Independent Research Lab · Local preview · No deployment
docLanguage: Architecture documents include Russian and English sections.
attemptNotice: Attempts are kept in server memory until restart or trial expiry.
rulesFixed: Rules language is fixed when loading a trial. Interface language can change independently.
legalHidden: Legal action hints are unavailable in the agent view.
stateUnchanged: An invalid proposal leaves the Core state unchanged.
publicNotice: Public preview: the interactive Core demo is currently available only in the local Lab.
publicRulesTitle: Interactive Rules Lab is not enabled publicly
publicRulesText: The Core runtime test passed locally in workerd. A public backend still needs abuse limits, deployment security and licensing review. Run the local Lab for Exam and Learning demonstrations. No validation result is simulated here.
